concerns.text: T003-PLV-REJECT creates a documentation artifact to 'reject' FR-003's PLV requirement, but the task does not update the spec or formally amend the requirement list. This leaves FR-003 (MUST calculate PLV) active and contradictory to the Plan's SDC implementation, violating the Single Source of Truth principle. The task must include a step to update spec.md or formally deprecate FR-003.

T050 mandates generating a 'synthetic dataset' (data/synthetic/color_motion.json) to visualize binding mechanisms. This violates Constitution Principle VI (Computational Neuro-Biological Fidelity) and Plan.md constraints which strictly mandate using verified OpenNeuro/CLUTRR sources and explicitly warn against synthetic data generation for MEG comparisons. The task introduces a scope violation not authorized by the spec.

T023 enforces a '< 25ms/token' latency threshold. The spec (US-1, AC-2) and Plan only define a total batch limit of '300 seconds per batch' for 8 sequences. The task introduces a stricter, undefined per-token metric not present in the requirements, effectively weakening the spec's defined acceptance criteria by adding an unverified constraint.

T007 requires zero-padding to 512 samples for Welch PSD. The spec (US-1, AC-1) specifies a sequence length of 50 tokens. The task does not verify that this padding strategy preserves the spectral peak integrity required to detect the 38-42Hz signal in such a short sequence, risking a failure to satisfy SC-001 (testability of the spectral peak) due to spectral leakage or resolution issues.

T008 is marked as completed ([X]) and a dependency of T007, yet T007 (the generation task) is unchecked. This creates a logical inversion where validation precedes generation. While primarily an execution error, it implies the 'Validation' acceptance criterion for the data pipeline is being claimed as satisfied before the data exists, violating the 'Fail loudly' and 'No synthetic fallback' constraints of the foundational phase.
